# load and inspect

```{r}
load_London_data <- function(file_path){
  LONDON_real_data <- read.csv("london-borough-profiles-2016 Data set.csv")
  print("Data loaded successfully")
  print(glimpse(LONDON_real_data))
  cat("\n--- First 10 Rows: ---\n")
  print(head(LONDON_real_data))
  return(LONDON_real_data)
  }

LONDON_f <- load_London_data("https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/rahulnadar123/housing-in-london-boroughs/data?select=london-borough-profiles-2016+Data+set.csv")
```

# Query function

```{r}
# turn into FUNCTION 
filter_household_density <- function(LONDON_f, Area_name){
  result <- LONDON_f|>
    filter(!is.na(GLA.Population.Estimate.2016)& !is.na(GLA.Household.Estimate.2016))|>
    mutate(household_density = as.numeric(as.character(GLA.Population.Estimate.2016))/ as.numeric(as.character(GLA.Household.Estimate.2016)) )|>
    select(Area.name, household_density) |>
    filter(Area.name == area_name)
    return(result)
}

# calling new function 
area_household_density <- filter_household_density
#print 
print (area_household_density)
```

# reporting Function

```{r}
colnames(LONDON_f)[colnames(LONDON_f) == "Area.name"] <- "Area"
      colnames(LONDON_f)
# report
generate_report <- function(Area_data,Area){
    Area_data <- LONDON_f|>
    filter (Area == Bexley )
    # Calculate stats
    avg_age <- mean(Area_data$Average.Age..2016, na.rm = TRUE)
    max_unempl <- max(Area_data$Unemployment.rate..2015.,na.rm = TRUE)
    min_unempl <- min(Area_data$Unemployment.rate..2015.,na.rm = TRUE)
    crime_rate <- length(Area_data$GLA.Population.Estimate.2016)
    record_count <- nrow(Area_data)
    # Print the report
    cat("--- Report for:", area_name, "---\n")
    cat("Average age:",avg_age,"\n")
    cat("maximum unemployment",max_unempl ,"\n")
    cat("minimum unemployment", min_unempl, "\n")
    cat("criame rate", crime_rate,"\n")
    cat("-----------------------------\n\n")  
}
    # Call 
generate_report
```
